# BigCollatz Research State

- **Final objective:** find a nontrivial cycle of the positive unaccelerated Collatz map with exact repeated-state detection on every generated state.
- **Latest completed full experiment:** `e004-s3-recursive-weighted-lineages-256`.
- **Current best complete starting integer:** ``.
- **Current best trajectory length:** 27,707.
- **Repeated state found:** no exact repeated state has been detected in any current full experiment or pilot.
- **Tested strategies:** S0 baseline (E001); S1 256-prefix global-top lineage search (E002); S2 weighted E002 lineages (E003); S3 recursive weighted E003 lineages (E004); S4 mixed 128/256/384 global-top prefixes (P003); S1 384-prefix pilot (P002); S1 128-prefix pilot (P004); S5 productivity-weighted prefix cells (P005); S6 best-neighborhood suffix perturbation (P006 and P007).
- **Rejected or inconclusive hypotheses:** S1 384-prefix global-top pilot rejected for full scale; S4 mixed-prefix pilot inconclusive/weak for full promotion; S1 128-prefix pilot rejected because the high tail collapsed; S5 cell weighting improved median over uniform mixed prefixes but did not produce enough top-tail evidence for full promotion.
- **Strongest current signals:** recursive 256-prefix lineage weighting remains the best full-scale evidence and produced the 27,707 global maximum; S6 suffix perturbation around the E004 best start reproducibly produced distinct non-parent candidates tying 27,707 in two independent 300-candidate pilots, suggesting a local plateau not captured by parity-prefix-only reasoning.
- **Active hypothesis:** a decimal-neighborhood plateau around the current best starting integer is a stronger immediate target than another broad parent/prefix-cell sweep, and it may support an E005 full experiment after correctness gates.
- **Immediate next action:** run correctness gates for S6, verify deterministic regeneration, uniqueness, 1,000-digit candidates, source-parent exclusion, suffix-prefix preservation, exact repeated-state detection, and pilot isolation; then promote S6 to `e005-s6-best-neighborhood-suffix-perturbation` with exactly 10,000 candidates and seed `suffix-perturb-full-v1` if execution allowance permits.
